aws_service: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime / Amazon SQS / Amazon SNS / AWS Lambda / Amazon CloudWatch
guidance: Asynchronous messaging lets agents operate independently at their optimal pace, with message queues absorbing throughput variations and leveling load across the workflow. Synchronous request-response patterns create tight coupling that makes a slow downstream agent block the entire upstream chain. Async decouples producers from consumers so fast agents are not held up by slow ones.
how_to_check: • You have agent-to-agent and agent-to-service communications using asynchronous patterns by default, with synchronous communication reserved for interactions that genuinely require immediate responses. • You have compact message payloads that pass references rather than inline data. • You have agents processing messages at their own pace without being overwhelmed by upstream producers. For more information, see the AGENTPERF04-BP01 documentation.
